pools.notes: Deployed 2026-11-24, runner-free (user directive), funded from the APECS faucet hot wallet. Runs the independently reviewed bch-groth16-bn254-sound-native verifier with the pool rules as a role-2 COVENANT hook, under OUR solo-ceremony VK (zkey sha256 4a4e2543…, VK sha256 05250429…). Program: code 7,737 B sha256 0e82760211279f69…, redeem R 65 B, pieces 3,981/3,756. NO separate covenant and NO step-UTXO fleet: every pool UTXO (state NFT, shield deposits, fee floats) is locked to the same program P2SH32, and every action is a SIGNATURE-FREE 3-input spend (TXINPUTCOUNT==3 — no fee input; fees ride the locked UTXOs' sats; the P2SH32 script satisfaction IS the authorization). State NFT born at f8f215c3…:0 with commitment = the PUBLIC bootstrap-seed root 551108f6…510f (verified byte-identical to the chain-deployed v2/v4 genesis commitments) ‖ 32 zero bytes. Bootstrap: the PUBLIC seed notes (value 0, nk=1, published constants). Op 1 SHIELD 1,000,000: tx 582cefee285f2e3f9528c0958158bcb8c0eef72ff516d17dfcfa7e8180bb79a2 (28,138 B, fee 32,000 sats), VM-ACCEPTED in consensus AND standard on all 3 inputs, balance 0 → 1,000,000, broadcast 2026-11-24. Evidence: acceptance 14/14, red team 146/0, liveness sweeps 70+69 cases 0 failed (pusd-shielded-pool wip-role2-hook/). NOT yet drivable by the nito.cash wallet (their committed VK 27f6ea03… and their 7-input tx shape differ) — the client integration (VK/asset swap + 3-input builder) is the follow-up; their client remains the final approval per the user's standing directive.
